==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His favorite anime is ''[[wikipedia:en:Hunter_%C3%97_Hunter|Hunter × Hunter]]''.
* Is one of the most successful players in Turkey, having won 10 domestic championships.
* Nicknamed '''fabfab''' by his fans.
* Scored a pentakill with {{ci|Kha'Zix}} during a game against [[paiN Gaming]] in the [[Gamescom 2013/International Wildcard Tournament|Riot Season 3 International Wildcard Tournament]].
* His favourite animals are cats.
